spotlight.imageAlt: Modern residential apartment building interior representing consumer rent payments
spotlight.pitch: Bilt Rewards allows US tenants to earn loyalty points on residential rent payments without transaction fees while building credit history. The platform turns monthly rent into a proprietary consumer acquisition channel for mortgage and wealth products.
spotlight.problem: Rent is typically the largest household expense for renters, yet pays zero consumer rewards and historically failed to build credit bureau scores.
spotlight.product: A co-branded card and payment portal linked to over 4 million residential units, letting tenants pay rent fee-free with credit or ACH.
spotlight.customer: Urban professionals renting residential apartments, condominium owners paying HOA fees, and institutional property managers.
spotlight.businessModel: Interchange fees from non-rent merchant spend, real estate property management software fees, and referral bounties on mortgage conversions.
spotlight.funding: $200M latest round at a $3.1B valuation led by General Catalyst, with Wells Fargo as banking partner.
spotlight.competition: Traditional cash-back credit cards, rent payment software like Buildium, and regional bank consumer loyalty cards.
spotlight.risks: Card interchange margin compression, high customer acquisition rewards liability, and reliance on credit union and bank balance sheets.
spotlight.whatToWatch: Upcoming launch of automated student loan repayment rewards and home equity down-payment conversion accounts.

signalScore.rationale: Category definer converting primary consumer rent cash flow into retail banking and mortgage pipelines.
